pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Crafted at the Crafting Station; the three tiers need colony level 1, 10 and 20 respectively.$()$(br2)A magic compass always points at your colony's town hall, so you never lose your way home. The advanced tier also shows the town hall's coordinates in its tooltip, and the ultimate tier goes one step further: right-click and it teleports you straight there.
